verdict.rationale: Box provides building blocks (webhooks, event feeds, Box AI, MCP server, agent configurator) that could be composed into autonomous background automations, but there is no evidence of a native, first-party 'automation/workflow' engine that runs autonomously on triggers without external glue code (e.g. no Box Relay or scheduled-workflow docs in this pack). missing for 10: dedicated autonomous workflow/automation product (e.g. Box Relay) documentation, evidence of scheduled/triggered agent runs without external orchestration, and independent confirmation that such automations work reliably in production.
